questions.subject: Programming skills · Loops
questions.text: A tray has 4 rows with 5 slots in each row. An outer loop visits rows and an inner loop visits slots. How many slots are visited?
questions.explanation: The inner five visits repeat for each of four rows.

questions.subject: Programming skills · Loops
questions.text: What distinguishes a nested loop from two consecutive loops?
answers: One loop executes inside another loop's body
Both loops must have the same count
questions.explanation: Nesting places the inner repetition within each outer iteration.

questions.subject: Programming skills · Loops
questions.text: An outer loop runs 2 times and an inner loop runs 6 times per outer iteration. How many inner iterations occur?
questions.explanation: Each of the two outer iterations includes six inner iterations.

questions.subject: Programming skills · Loops
questions.text: An inner loop should restart for each new row. When should its starting value be set?
answers: At the start of each row's inner loop
questions.explanation: Each row needs a fresh traversal of its columns.
